issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares ExcellenceLand.excellencyLevel as type double, but the solution (and therefore what students might follow) declares excellencyLevel as int. This mismatch will confuse students about the correct attribute type and constructor signature expected by the specification/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the attribute type with the UML: change ExcellenceLand.excellencyLevel to double in the template and solution (update the field declaration, constructor parameter type, and getter return type to double). Alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to use int if that was intended, but ensure template, solution and specification consistently use the same type.
